questions.text: The radii of two solid spheres are in the ratio 2 : 3. What is the ratio of their volumes?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For similar 3D shapes, volume ratio is the cube of the linear ratio. (2/3)^3 = 8/27. Full: Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³. Ratio V1/V2 = (r1/r2)³ = (2/3)³ = 8/27.

questions.text: In which state of matter do particles have the highest kinetic energy and move freely?
questions.solution: In gases, particles possess high kinetic energy, allowing them to overcome intermolecular forces and move rapidly in random directions. Solids have fixed positions with low vibrational energy, liquids have moderate energy allowing flow but limited separation, while plasma, though having even higher energy, is an ionized state distinct from simple thermal motion of neutral particles in this context.

questions.text: What is the largest planet in our solar system in terms of mass?
questions.solution: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system in terms of mass, with a mass approximately 318 times that of Earth.

questions.text: Rohan walks 15 metres towards East. He then turns left and walks 20 metres. He turns left again and walks 15 metres. Finally, he turns right and walks 10 metres. How far is he from the starting point and in which direction?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Track Net Displacement. East-West: +15 (East) then -15 (West) = 0. North-South: +20 (North) then +10 (North) = 30m North. Distance = 30m North. Step-by-step: Start at Origin. 1. East 15m → (15, 0). 2. Left (North) 20m → (15, 20). 3. Left (West) 15m → (0, 20). 4. Right (North) 10m → (0, 30). Final position is 30m North of start.

questions.text: Which of the following Indian states is known as the 'Sugar Bowl' of India due to its high sugarcane production and processing capacity?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate based on primary crop identity. Karnataka and Gujarat are major for cotton or petrochemicals; while Maharashtra produces sugar, Uttar Pradesh is historically and statistically the undisputed leader in cane area and crushing capacity. Step-by-step: 1. Identify the 'Sugar Bowl' moniker in Indian geography. 2. Recall that Uttar Pradesh consistently ranks first in sugarcane production volume and mill capacity among all states. 3. Verify against options: UP matches the definition perfectly, making it the correct choice.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the number of Operational Commands for the three services of the Indian Armed Forces, what is the total number of Operational Commands?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Army (7) + Air Force (7) = 14. Navy has 3. 14 + 3 = 17. Eliminate 15, 16, 18. Worked Solution: Indian Army has 7 operational commands (Western, Eastern, Northern, Southern, South Western, Central, Army Training Command). Indian Air Force has 7 operational commands (Western, Eastern, Central, South Western, Southern, Training, Maintenance). Indian Navy has 3 operational commands (Western, Eastern, Southern). Total = 7 + 7 + 3 = 17.

questions.text: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.solution: Article 32 provides for the right to move the Supreme Court for the enforcement of fundamental rights, often called the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution. Article 14 deals with equality before law, Article 19 with freedoms like speech and movement, and Article 21 with protection of life and personal liberty.

questions.text: Which of the following compounds contains nitrogen in the +5 oxidation state?
questions.solution: Shortcut: In a neutral compound, sum of oxidation states = 0. Oxygen is -2 each. For N2O5, total O = 5 × (-2) = -10. Let oxidation state of N be x. Then 2x + (-10) = 0 → 2x = +10 → x = +5. Full solution: Assign oxidation numbers: O = -2. For each option calculate N's oxidation state. NO: x -2 = 0 → x = +2. N2O5: 2x -10 = 0 → x = +5. NO2: x -4 = 0 → x = +4. N2O: 2x -2 = 0 → x = +1. Only N2O5 gives +5.

questions.text: Who was the last Mughal Emperor of India?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate Aurangzeb (died 1707, peak of empire). Eliminate Shah Alam II (reigned 1759-1806, Battle of Buxar). The name 'Zafar' is synonymous with the 1857 Revolt and exile to Rangoon. Worked Solution: Bahadur Shah Zafar (Abu Zafar Siraj-ud-din Muhammad Bahadur Shah Zafar) was the 20th and last Mughal Emperor. He reigned from 1837 to 1857. After the Indian Rebellion of 1857, the British exiled him to Rangoon (Yangon), Burma, where he died in 1862, marking the formal end of the Mughal dynasty.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, "He is the only son of the only daughter of my husband's father." How is the man in the photograph related to the woman?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Decode backwards from the speaker. 'My husband's father' is the woman's Father-in-law. The 'only daughter' of Father-in-law is the woman herself (assuming no sisters-in-law). The 'only son' of the woman is her Son. Step-by-step: 1. Woman's Husband's Father = Father-in-law. 2. Only daughter of Father-in-law = The Woman (speaker). 3. Only son of the Woman = Woman's Son. Therefore, the man is her Son.

questions.text: If x = √3 + √2, find the value of x² + 1/x².
questions.solution: Shortcut: Rationalize 1/x = 1/(√3+√2) = √3-√2. Then x + 1/x = (√3+√2) + (√3-√2) = 2√3. Use identity x² + 1/x² = (x + 1/x)² - 2 = (2√3)² - 2 = 12 - 2 = 10. Full: x = √3+√2. 1/x = √3-√2 (rationalizing). x + 1/x = 2√3. Squaring both sides: x² + 1/x² + 2 = 12. Therefore, x² + 1/x² = 10.

questions.text: Find the unit digit of the product (7^95 × 3^58).
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use cyclicity of unit digits. For 7, cycle (7,9,3,1) length 4; 95 mod 4 = 3 → unit digit 3. For 3, cycle (3,9,7,1) length 4; 58 mod 4 = 2 → unit digit 9. Product unit digit = 3 × 9 = 27 → 7. Full: 7^95 = 7^(4×23+3) ends in 3. 3^58 = 3^(4×14+2) ends in 9. 3 × 9 = 27, so final unit digit is 7.

questions.text: Select the letter that will come next in the following series: A, C, F, J, O, ?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Convert letters to their positional values (A=1, C=3, F=6, J=10, O=15). Find the differences: +2, +3, +4, +5. The difference increases by 1 each step. Next difference is +6. 15 + 6 = 21. The 21st letter is U. Step-by-step: Position of A=1. C=3 (diff +2). F=6 (diff +3). J=10 (diff +4). O=15 (diff +5). Pattern of differences is consecutive integers starting from 2. Next difference = 6. Required position = 15 + 6 = 21. 21st letter of alphabet = U.

questions.text: A train 150 metres long crosses an electric pole in 15 seconds. How much time will it take to cross a platform 350 metres long?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Speed = Train Length / Time = 150/15 = 10 m/s. Total distance to cross platform = Train + Platform = 150 + 350 = 500 m. Time = Distance / Speed = 500/10 = 50 s. Full: Speed of train = 150 m / 15 s = 10 m/s. Distance to cover platform = 150 m + 350 m = 500 m. Required time = 500 m / 10 m/s = 50 seconds.

questions.text: The 'Mangalyaan' mission (Mars Orbiter Mission) was launched by ISRO in which year?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Remember the 'Diwali Launch' trick. MOM was launched on 5 November 2013 (Diwali week) via PSLV-C25. It entered Mars orbit on 24 September 2014. Worked Solution: The Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM), colloquially Mangalyaan, was launched on 5 November 2013 from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota. It made India the first Asian nation to reach Martian orbit and the first nation in the world to do so in its maiden attempt. The launch year 2013 is the key fact.
